decisions.reason: A reissued jazz vinyl LP draws directly on the firm's core knowledge of curating and reissuing overlooked music, so it can interpret demand from collectors and keep the title in its catalog at low cost.
Multi-disc box sets fit the firm's carefully produced editions and established label skills, and long-tail collector demand justifies keeping the set in stock, although limited runs may sell out.

The compilation CD sits close to the established offer and costs little to hold in a warehouse-backed catalog, but it got only weak presentation and resembles the dropped schlager compilation, which raises the risk of withdrawal.
